releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.32 refreshes Files > My Categories with a calmer premium two-column layout: smaller category icons, softer depth, equal card heights, aligned two-line names, consistent file counts and subtle navigation. Manage Categories is now a focused workspace with Add, single-category Rename, multi-category Merge, Delete, and drag-to-reorder. Merging moves Smart Life category assignments only; deleting a category removes the label only. Physical files remain in their original Android folders. Notes spelling behavior from v0.11.31 and the latest Inbox improvements are preserved.
